fields.summary_ko.0: Meta Platforms (META -5.93%) went public as Facebook in 2012 and changed its name in 2021 to focus on metaverse investment, with over 3 billion monthly active users generating advertising revenue.
fields.summary_ko.1: Meta is included in the Nasdaq and S&P 500 indices with approximately 368.8 million shares held across 773 ETFs, with the Vanguard Communications Services ETF (VOX -3.04%) allocating its largest weight of 24.7% to Meta.
